review.instruction: Confirm existing authorization covers the project, environment, target and deploy action; quality and optional migration evidence bind the same immutable release and manifest digest.
Verify each host, artifact, schema, domain and rollout effect used observed before and after revisions, stayed within the one target, and did not repeat an uncertain mutation.

Check at least two timestamped health and readiness observations over the bounded window, including a public probe, prove the active digest, and reject a single successful sample or assumed stability.

Confirm rollout failure enters only approved reversible recovery for the same release; exhausted recovery enters exact-digest rollback; rollback compatibility and identity are proven before restoration.
Confirm no third release became active during execution. Any concurrent or uncertain state stops further effects until a fresh observation and authorization-bound plan exist.

failurePolicy: Evaluate deployment evidence into concrete defects. Repair only within two feedback rounds, observe target state before every retry, and never duplicate deploy or rollback effects whose completion is uncertain.
